name: Configure System Settings
description: Guide to configure basic system settings and preferences

steps.title: Open Settings Menu
steps.description: Click on the gear icon or 'Settings' option in the top navigation bar or user menu.

steps.title: Navigate to General Settings
steps.description: Select 'General' or 'System Settings' from the settings sidebar to access basic configuration options.

steps.title: Update Organization Details
steps.description: Enter or update your organization name, timezone, and default language preferences.

steps.title: Configure Notification Preferences
steps.description: Choose which types of notifications you want to receive via email, in-app, or push notifications.

steps.title: Save Changes
steps.description: Click the 'Save' or 'Apply Changes' button at the bottom of the page to save your configuration.
